# HexPiece 3.5.6

The Mochi Mochi no Mi's arms and fists, redone to the reference (the owner: the arms are "basically rectangles ... with the fist at
the very edge"). Not tested in game yet: the build and the tests pass.

- Every stretched mochi arm is now a straight bar with flat, square sides, the same width all the way (no more thin round tube).
- The fist is the bar's very end: a block a little wider than the arm, with four square knuckles across its front and the thumb folded
  under them. The left arm ends in a left fist.
- Applies everywhere: Mochi Punch, the Anemone's arms, Muso Donuts' giant fists, Yaki Mochi's flying fist, Kaku Mochi's arms and Zan
  Giri Mochi's club arm.
- With Armament on, the whole bar and fist are black with the blue edge shine; without it, fully white.
